The tweet includes several emojis: a basketball, a football, a globe, a heart, and a checkmark. The image attached to the tweet shows a large group of people on a boat named "BATEAUX MOUCHES," which is docked at what appears to be a port. The people on the boat are waving American flags and appear to be celebrating. Some individuals are holding purple flags with white text that is partially visible,
